alias: Family room music: Pioneer off after 15 quiet minutes
description: Turns the Pioneer SX-780 off once the WiiM hasn't played for 15 minutes. Not while the WiiM is on a wired input (TV, Phono, Line In, Optical), where it may be passing sound through without reporting it as playing.

conditions.value_template: {% set w = states.media_player.family_room_family_room_wiim %}{{ w is none or (w.state != 'playing' and (now() - w.last_changed).total_seconds() >= 900 and w.attributes.source not in ['TV', 'Phono In', 'Line In', 'Optical In']) }}
